Game Overview

Mini Jumps puts players into a action experience centered on guide a sticky orange slime through vibrant puzzles where precise jumps and quick reflexes are key. Master timing to navigate moving platforms, aiming for flowers while avoiding crushing traps. With its engaging mechanics and thoughtful design, Mini Jumps promises a deceptively simple yet captivating adventure.
